description: Return the specification a pattern maker works from for a garment: points of measure with tolerances at a base size, the fabric class, weight band and stretch behaviour, and the seam and hem allowance convention. Free, stores nothing, needs no account. This is the SPEC, not the pattern: the DXF itself is cut by a human pattern maker on a paid order, and it is delivered NET of seam allowance unless the seam allowance extra ($5) is bought.

base_size.description: Base size for the measurement table: XS, S, M, L, XL. Defaults to M.

description.description: Construction detail that refines the read: panels, lining, closures, pockets

fabric_class.description: How the fabric behaves. Decides the stretch note and the cutting warnings.

garment_type.description: Garment family in plain words: "structured blazer", "midi dress", "hoodie"
